annotation.title_clean: 国家机关事务管理局 国家发展和改革委员会关于印发《“十五五”公共机构节能降碳工作方案》的通知
annotation.title_en: Notice of the National Government Offices Administration and NDRC on Issuing the "15th Five-Year Plan" Work Plan for Energy Saving and Carbon Reduction in Public Institutions
annotation.authors_or_issuer: 国家机关事务管理局; 国家发展和改革委员会
annotation.summary_en: Chinese national work plan (July 2026) for energy saving and carbon reduction in public institutions during the 15th Five-Year Plan. It sets 2030 targets for carbon, energy and water reductions, and covers retrofits, renewable energy, resource conservation and training. It has no AI or robotics governance content.
key_provisions_or_claims: By 2030, carbon emissions per unit floor area fall 8.5%, energy use 5%, and per-capita water use 3%.
Coal must be under 5% of energy consumption and electricity 65% in public institutions.
At least 80% of newly added key energy equipment must be at advanced efficiency levels.
Revise the Public Institution Energy Conservation Regulations and strengthen standards and metering.
Big data, AI and IoT are mentioned only for energy data management.
